#Task 1
```{r}
# Load Dataset
data <- read.csv("C:/M.Sc/DecodaLabs-internship/Rural_and_Urban_Population_and_Decadal_Change.csv")

head(data)

str(data)

dim(data)
```

```{r}

dim(data)        
nrow(data)       
ncol(data)       

colnames(data)

str(data)

summary(data)

colSums(is.na(data))

cat("Number of Rows:", nrow(data), "\n")
cat("Number of Columns:", ncol(data), "\n")

sapply(data, class)
```

#Task 2
```{r}

cat("Missing Values in Each Column:\n")
colSums(is.na(data))

numeric_cols <- sapply(data, is.numeric)

for(i in names(data[numeric_cols])) {
  data[is.na(data[, i]), i] <- mean(data[, i], na.rm = TRUE)
}

cat("Number of Duplicate Rows:",
    sum(duplicated(data)), "\n")

data <- unique(data)

str(data)

data$Districts <- as.character(data$Districts)

cat("Missing Values After Cleaning:\n")
colSums(is.na(data))

cat("Final Number of Rows:", nrow(data), "\n")
cat("Final Number of Columns:", ncol(data), "\n")

write.csv(data,
          "cleaned_dataset.csv",
          row.names = FALSE)

cat("Data cleaning completed successfully!")
```

#Task 3
```{r}

summary(data)

numeric_cols <- sapply(data, is.numeric)

mean_values <- sapply(data[, numeric_cols], mean, na.rm = TRUE)
median_values <- sapply(data[, numeric_cols], median, na.rm = TRUE)
sd_values <- sapply(data[, numeric_cols], sd, na.rm = TRUE)

cat("Mean Values:\n")
print(mean_values)

cat("Median Values:\n")
print(median_values)

cat("Standard Deviations:\n")
print(sd_values)

boxplot(data[, numeric_cols],
        main = "Boxplots for Numeric Variables",
        las = 2)

cor_matrix <- cor(data[, numeric_cols])
print(cor_matrix)

corrplot::corrplot(cor_matrix,
                   method = "color",
                   tl.cex = 0.7)

top_pop <- data[order(-data$Population.2011_Total_Rural.Urban), ]

head(top_pop[, c("Districts",
                 "Population.2011_Total_Rural.Urban")], 10)

hist(data$Population.2011_Total_Rural.Urban,
     main = "Distribution of Total Population",
     xlab = "Population")

cat("EDA Completed Successfully")
```

#Task 4
```{r}


top10 <- data[order(-data$Population.2011_Total_Rural.Urban), ][1:10, ]

barplot(top10$Population.2011_Total_Rural.Urban,
        names.arg = top10$Districts,
        las = 2,
        main = "Top 10 Districts by Total Population",
        ylab = "Population")

hist(data$Population.2011_Total_Rural.Urban,
     main = "Distribution of Total Population",
     xlab = "Population",
     breaks = 10)

boxplot(data$Population.2011_Total_Rural.Urban,
        main = "Boxplot of Total Population",
        ylab = "Population")

plot(data$Population.2011_Rural_Total,
     data$Population.2011_Urban_Total,
     main = "Rural vs Urban Population",
     xlab = "Rural Population",
     ylab = "Urban Population",
     pch = 19)

abline(lm(Population.2011_Urban_Total ~
          Population.2011_Rural_Total,
          data = data))

rural_total <- sum(data$Population.2011_Rural_Total)
urban_total <- sum(data$Population.2011_Urban_Total)

pie(c(rural_total, urban_total),
    labels = c("Rural", "Urban"),
    main = "Share of Rural and Urban Population")
```
